text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text: Fuh... ngh, haaaaaaaaaaah!!

text_block_list.name: Racing Umamusumes
text_block_list.text: Guuuugh...!! No, I can't... anymore—

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
—Not yet!! Like I'd let you pass 
meeeee!!!!

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text: Fufu... That's right! In that case...!

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text: I'll pull away!!!!

text_block_list.name: Blast Onepiece
text_block_list.text: Oooooooh…………!! Aiiiieee, go for itttt~~!!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
Even the Triple Crown is just a stepping 
stone for this Umamusume!! Almond Eye 
captures the Triple Tiara! Magnificent!!

text_block_list.name: Spectators
text_block_list.text:
"Congratulations, Ai-chan!" "Congrats on 
winning the Triple Tiara--!" "Thank you 
for the shockwaves~~!"

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text: Yaaaay!!

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
Ohh... She's super happy! Well yeah, the 
fifth Triple Tiara Umamusume in history... 
It's a monumental achievement...!

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text: Alright, yes...! I pulled off the win...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Calling out to her in my heart, I hurried 
backstage so I'd be fully prepared to care 
for Almond Eye when she returned—

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text: Fufu. I'm sure you will too...—

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
"—Aaaaargh!! I couldn't beat her in the 
end............!!"

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
How pathetic!! Seriously... that was so 
freakin' lame...!

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text: ...... ...But I won't give up.

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
No matter how long it takesâI will bloom 
in all my glory.

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text: Trainer! Hey! You too—

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text: Huh? Ah, that's right...

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text: ...Hk, phew, thank you—
choice_data_list: Sorry, can I leave the icing to you?

Sorry, do you mind taking care of the 
icing?

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text: Yes, of course...

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
choice_data_list:
Alright, I'm ready. Next up, the 
shoulders—

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text: Hold on, time out for a second!

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
I think I've let off most of the heat now! 
Thank you! So...—

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text: —Be way happier for me!

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text: "I won, you know? I—"

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
I'm a Triple Tiara Umamusume now! —Which 
means, I win!

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
Come on! How are you feeling right now? 
Tell me!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (Waaaaaah...!!!!)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
In an instant, the memory of her victory 
returns. At the time, my mind was too 
preoccupied with what came next... but 
now, a delayed fire ignites in my chest—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
All the conversations built up until 
today... The days we worked hard 
together... flashed through my mind in a 
whirlwind—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
A blinding wave of joy—burst right before 
my eyes.

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text: Hey! What are you feeling right now?

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text: Fufu. Yes, absolutely!

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text: This feels absoluteeeely amazing...!

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
I know what you mean by being speechless! 
It's like words just can't describe it... 
hehe!

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text: —...It's so much fun. Truly!

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Ai-chan!

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Good work out there! And... 
congratulations on winning the Triple 
Tiara!

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text: Thank you! ...Oh, wasn't Blast with you?

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
"I asked them to wait just a moment. 
—There's something I want to tell you."

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Almond Eye!

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
"—How about facing off against me in the 
Japan Cup?"

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
...Yes! Nailed it! That felt just like a 
battle manga for teens!

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
"Your running today was incredible! So 
ridiculously powerful... so dazzling—"

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
"I was captivated. I could feel it. —That 
you have what it takes to be the 
protagonist."

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Looking straight up and charging forward! 
You fit that strong protagonist archetype 
perfectly.

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
――But even I... want to be the 
protagonist!

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
In this upcoming Japan Cup, a race where 
so many stars gather—

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Let's settle once and for all... who the 
real protagonist is!

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text: ...Ngh!

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text: "Hey, Trainer! I—"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The Japan Cup is a high-level race to 
decide the strongest in the country. 
Battle-hardened Senior Class seniors will 
also be running, making it a fierce 
battle, but—

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text: ...! Of course!

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
I accept your challenge, Kiseki-chan. That 
greedy, hungry look in your eyes—I want to 
beat it!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, the next target race was decided: 
the Japan Cup. Almond Eye's march 
forward—would not stop.
